mentions.name: pgfdb
mentions.description: A Postgres extension that runs Postgres on top of FoundationDB, aiming to turn Postgres into a distributed, horizontally scalable database with automatic sharding and replication.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on extending Postgres to run on top of FoundationDB. The goal would be turning Postgres into a distributed, horizontally scalable database with automatic sharding and replication.
